name: Daiwa Office Investment Corporation
summary: Daiwa Office Investment Corporation is a public investment firm. DOI is an externally managed real estate fund, established as an investment corporation. The company primarily invests in office buildings located in Tokyo's five central wards and other major urban areas in Japan. It generates revenue through rental income and property management activities while seeking to enhance unitholder value through portfolio expansion, asset repositioning, and active real estate management. The company is externally managed by Daiwa Real Estate Asset Management Co., Ltd. and was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in 2005.
